accepted_claims.text: For the recorded CrewAI 1.15.21 same-process synchronous ToolUsage._use retry boundary, an unguarded tool whose external effect commits and then raises before returning can be re-entered by the built-in retry and produce a second external effect for one logical action.

claim_ceiling: Independent byte/invariant verification of the frozen CrewAI retry receipts only; not an attestation of the original execution environment or a framework-wide safety guarantee.
non_claims: No claim is made about fresh-process recovery or checkpoint/resume behavior.
No independent rerun of the original 90 trials is established by admission.
No fresh-process, checkpoint/resume, external-retrigger, global exactly-once, or framework-wide safety claim is established.
